description: Specialized TEAM and SKILL pack for the nonprofit-operations career: field how-tos for stretching tiny budgets and running programs with what's on hand (improvised event production, donation ops, pantry lines, borrowed-space programs), career-skill entries that refine the craft (grant writing and budgeting, donor stewardship, fundraising pipelines, board governance, career leveling from volunteer to coordinator), and team-play entries for how nonprofit staffs and volunteer crews coordinate, train fast, improvise together under pressure, and avoid burnout — all feeding toward personal refinement tools.
notes_for_main_builder: Ids normalized by coordinator to the framework law (curriculum/schema.py: sw-general-nonprofit-NNN); full file validates clean against validate_entry. Domain 'general'. Prerequisites are pack-local only. No stubs.

track_emphasis.build: secondary — check-in desks, driver networks, monthly-donor pipelines, substitute benches
track_emphasis.combine: tertiary — multi-drive events, combined funder reports, cross-trained floaters
track_emphasis.create: secondary — appeal letters, sponsorship menus, elevator pitches, boilerplate kits
track_emphasis.improve: primary — stewardship cadence, career leveling, burnout watch, meeting and reporting discipline
track_emphasis.improvise: primary — stretching tiny budgets, borrowed gear, no-show crews, zero-print outreach
track_emphasis.restore: secondary — donor-database cleanup, declined-grant debriefs, staff-volunteer friction repair
